cases.name: a name query answers names
cases.purpose: A search for a name that Lean does not know answers hits, each a name with the backend that found it. It needs a backend set up (an index of Mathlib, or a service): the harness checks every hit with Lean before it shows one.

cases.name: a private run asks no third party
cases.purpose: With private set, a backend that sends the query away is not asked: it comes back as skipped with its reason.
